summary: Overview of third-party apps and devices that let others follow AAPS glucose and treatment data without controlling AAPS: Dexcom Follow, Nightguard, Nightwatch, xDrip, xDrip4iOS, Sugarmate, Spike, and glucose display devices. Labels on this page belong to those apps, not to AAPS.
